question:
Which letter-cluster will come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series and complete the series?

EMRT, ?, IGVN, KDXK, MAZH
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

Logic : Alternately (2) is added to and (3) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series respectively. 

​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32f42677b9ca7b06fc3fae3b7a883550d5bfadc1b7ce4d167cf4c6d25a16ee31.png] ​

Hence, "**GJTQ**" is the correct answer.
